description: This file contains authentication and authorization helper functions for a FastAPI backend, including password hashing, JWT encoding/decoding, and user retrieval dependencies.

methods.name: verify_password
methods.description: Verify a plain password against its hash.

methods.name: hash_password
methods.description: Hash a password for storing in db.

methods.name: create_access_token
methods.description: Generate a JWT access token with expiration.

methods.name: decode_access_token
methods.description: Decode a JWT access token and return the payload if valid.

methods.name: get_current_user
methods.description: FastAPI dependency to get user from JWT token.
